findings: Smaller actual timber sections make the three courses more readable and the diagonal corner brace is visible under the hip member.
Warm wood and lifted window-bar reflectance improve material separation, but the full facade is still too uniformly orange and the smooth constant profiles remain synthetic.
The original tall bearing transform leaves the new narrow dou too upright; the large recessed plank head remains prominent and the ranks need more compact spacing.
Repeated secondary infinity-like metal scrolls remain a visibly schematic motif, unlike the reference varied worked metal faces.
The low side render shows real joinery and roof relationships rather than only the ceramic terminal; exposed rafter cuts still flash pale and the continuous eave members are too uniformly square.
next: Rebuild compact receiver spacing and reduce only the capital height around retained roof/purlin contact; repair overall profile, not just an exposure scalar.
Replace schematic cloud ribbons with closed domed cast leaves and incised return details, and add shallow geometry molding to continuous timbers.
limits: This is draft image review, not acceptance. Sky/canopy/camera-wide alignment are still visibly different.
